Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Performance Marketer position at Distrilink. As a junior digital marketer with a strong analytical foundation and hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web analytics, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your clients' growth across European marketplaces.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, keyword research, and performance tracking using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. I have also built and optimized WordPress sites, implementing structured data and technical audits to improve visibility. My project mirook.com demonstrates my ability to apply data-driven strategies to enhance search performance.

I am comfortable with numbers, Excel, and dashboards, and I am eager to learn marketplace advertising platforms like Amazon and Bol.com. My fluency in English and Turkish, along with ongoing Dutch studies (B1), aligns with your language requirements. I am precise, structured, and quick to adapt to new tools.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills can support Distrilink's fast-growing team. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Junior Performance Marketer position at Distrilink. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web analytics, and a strong analytical mindset, I am eager to contribute to your mission of helping consumer brands scale across European marketplaces.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in on-page SEO, keyword research, and content optimization. I use tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console to track performance and guide decisions. I have also built and maintained WordPress sites, implementing structured data and technical SEO audits to improve visibility. My project mirook.com showcases my ability to apply these skills independently, from site design to AI-search optimization.

I am comfortable with numbers and data analysis, having worked with analytics dashboards and Excel in my daily tasks. I am eager to apply this analytical rigor to advertising campaigns, monitoring KPIs like ACOS, CTR, and conversion rates. While my experience is primarily in organic search, I have a foundational understanding of Google Ads and am quick to learn new platforms like Amazon and Bol.com advertising.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, and I am actively improving my Dutch (currently B1). I am precise, structured, and thrive in fast-paced environments, as demonstrated by my previous work in logistics. I am excited about the opportunity to work with Distrilink's proprietary AI platform and grow within a dynamic, international team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a strong analytical foundation and hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web analytics. At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site builds, using data to guide decisions. On my own project (mirook.com), I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable with numbers, Excel, and dashboards, and eager to grow into performance marketing and marketplace advertising. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)
